recognize_zh: 淋巴結右側被膜明顯增厚，由成束、細胞稀少的粉紅色緻密膠原構成，外側可見被膜外脂肪與出血；被膜下方淋巴組織內有一個具套區的反應性次級濾泡，屬淋巴結發炎性偽瘤的被膜纖維化表現。
features: Markedly thickened nodal capsule composed of dense, hypocellular, parallel collagen bands
Perinodal adipose tissue and fresh hemorrhage outside the thickened capsule
Fibrous extension along the subcapsular region with a slit-like vessel
Reactive secondary follicle with germinal center and mantle zone near the lower field
Adjacent lymphoid parenchyma with mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels, no atypical infiltrate
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows marked fibrous thickening of the capsule by dense, hypocellular bands of collagen, with perinodal fat and hemorrhage beyond it. Beneath the capsule, the nodal parenchyma is preserved and contains a reactive secondary follicle with a germinal center and mantle zone, surrounded by mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels. No atypical cells are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the capsular fibrosis of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor, which characteristically begins in the capsule and trabeculae before extending into the parenchyma.

ddx.vs: NSCHL also thickens the capsule but forms collagen bands that encircle cellular nodules containing lacunar/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are not present here.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and markedly increased IgG4+ plasma cells, whereas this case had only a mild IgG4+ increase.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific capsular fibrosis from prior inflammation or chronic lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Nonspecific fibrosis is thin and lacks the fibroinflammatory spindle-cell and plasma cell-rich expansion of trabeculae and paracortex that defines inflammatory pseudotumor on other fields.
